output.summary: A tropical evergreen tree native to tropical South America, cashew bears a kidney-shaped true fruit at the end of a larger red or yellow cashew apple. The raw seed and its shell are toxic, but the seed is edible after shelling and roasting or steaming; the cashew apple is also eaten or made into drinks.
output.edibilityNote: The seed is edible after shelling and roasting or steaming; the cashew apple is eaten fresh or processed into drinks, preserves and other foods.
